purpose: Fail-closed editorial workflow for rechecking stale YouNew records without treating URL reachability as factual verification.

statuses.confirmed_current: A reviewer opened an authoritative source and confirmed the listed fields on the review date.
statuses.source_reachable_fact_review_pending: The source responded, but the facts in the record have not yet been checked.
statuses.source_restricted_fact_review_pending: The source blocked automated access; a human review is still required.
statuses.source_unavailable: The source could not be reached and a replacement source must be investigated.
statuses.conflict_found: A source contradicts the record; publication state and corrective action require editorial review.

rules: HTTP reachability never upgrades verification_status or last_checked.
confirmed_current requires an authoritative URL, review date, reviewer identity, and an explicit list of confirmed fields.
Only confirmed_current may update last_checked and official_source.checked_at.
Conflicts fail closed and are queued for editorial correction before any verified label is shown.
Records are not deleted automatically; superseded or closed records require an evidence-backed editorial decision.
Business contact research stores public business channels only and never collects personal addresses without a lawful basis.
